title: Finite field degree
statement: For an executable Vandermonde input with output dimension $n$, define the field degree to be $\max(1,\lceil\log_2 n\rceil)$, where $\lceil\log_2 n\rceil$ is the least natural number $d$ such that $2^d\geq n$.
